mode.title: What to fetch
enumTitles: Exports or imports by commodity group
mode.description: `countries`: total exports, imports and balance for an area and each partner country in it. `commodities`: value (and quantity where published) for about 55 commodity groups (概況品), for one partner and flow.

from.title: From period
from.description: YYYY or YYYY-MM (inclusive, month 01-12). With yearly frequency a month is accepted and the whole year is included. Leave empty for the full history.

to.title: To period
to.description: YYYY or YYYY-MM (inclusive). Leave empty for the latest published period.

areas.title: Areas (countries mode)
areas.description: 世界 = world totals only. Regions (アジア, 北米, EU, ASEAN …) also list every partner country in the region.

partnerCodes.title: Partner country codes (countries mode)
partnerCodes.description: Optional filter by Japan Customs country code, e.g. `105` (China), `103` (Korea), `304` (USA). Use `Total` for the area total row.

commodityCodes.title: Commodity codes, both flows (commodities mode)
commodityCodes.description: Optional filter by commodity code (applies to both flows). Codes differ between the export and import tables (e.g. semiconductors etc. are 70323 in exports, 70311 in imports) — use the per-flow fields below, or the name filter, when filtering both flows. Examples: `0-9` (total), `703` (electrical machinery, exports).

exportCommodityCodes.title: Export commodity codes (commodities mode)
exportCommodityCodes.description: Codes used only for the export table, e.g. `70323` (semiconductors etc.).

importCommodityCodes.title: Import commodity codes (commodities mode)
importCommodityCodes.description: Codes used only for the import table, e.g. `70311` (semiconductors etc.).

commodityNameContains.title: Commodity name contains (commodities mode)
commodityNameContains.description: Keep commodity groups whose Japanese name or top-level group contains one of these strings, e.g. `半導体`, `自動車`, `医薬品`. Works across flows.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Maximum number of rows to output.

requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestIntervalMs.description: Pause between file downloads. Minimum 1000 ms.
